title: Central Portugal architecture
description: In the central part of the country, you'll find these dark-stone houses, which are very typical of the area between Coimbra and Castelo Branco.

title: Lemon orchards on the south coast
description: The only lemon orchards found in Portugal are along the south coast (Algarve).

title: Dark stone houses of central Portugal
description: In the centre of the country, very typical houses of dark stone (schist) are found, confined to the area between Coimbra and Castelo Branco.

title: Shiny white pavement cobbles
description: Small, white, shiny cobblestones (calçada) cover pavements throughout Portugal and are found only there, an extremely common clue to tell it apart from Spain.

title: Hunting zone signs
description: Rural Portugal often has small signs marking a hunting area: a white circle in a red square, sometimes accompanied by a placard in the same colours.
